falseSynonyms.zh: 取件不等於送貨 collection 通常是從顧客／地點收取貨物，方向與 delivery 相反或處於前一步。
falseSynonyms.point: The courier collected the parcel in the morning and delivered it in the afternoon.

falseSynonyms.zh: 取貨／自取不等於送到客戶 pickup 可指快遞取件，也可指顧客到店自取。
付運／運輸比 delivery 更廣 shipping 可涵蓋長途運輸、國際運送和整個出貨過程，不一定是最後送到客戶。
falseSynonyms.point: Shipping brought the goods to the country; delivery took them to the customer.

falseSynonyms.zh: 運輸不等於交付 transport 強調移動人或貨物，不一定包括交到收件人的最後一步。
falseSynonyms.point: Transport moves goods; delivery hands them over at the destination.

falseSynonyms.zh: 出貨不等於送達 dispatch 表示貨物已從倉庫／賣家發出，之後仍可能在運送途中。
falseSynonyms.point: The parcel was dispatched Monday and delivered Tuesday.

falseSynonyms.zh: 配送網絡比單次 delivery 更廣 distribution 通常描述把大量貨品分送到多個地點的系統。
falseSynonyms.point: Distribution covers the network; delivery may refer to one customer's order.

falseSynonyms.zh: 貨運偏大量／商業運輸 freight 常指大宗貨物或其運輸，不等於一般顧客送貨。
falseSynonyms.point: The freight arrived by rail before local delivery began.

falseSynonyms.zh: 收貨是接收方的結果 receipt 是收到貨物／文件，並不是送貨服務本身。
falseSynonyms.point: Delivery occurred at noon; receipt was confirmed by signature.
